name: Can you dispute a Kraken transaction? [ Is it Possible ]]
original_name: Can you dispute a Kraken transaction? [ Is it Possible ]]
overview: You generally cannot dispute a transaction on Kraken once it is completed, as crypto transfers are irreversible and recorded on the blockchain  📞  +1 ❰833❱ ➥ 59 0 ➥ 1784  Kraken cannot cancel or charge back confirmed transactions ☎(1)(833)-(590)-(1784)↪. If there’s an issue, you can contact support for guidance, 🍁【(+1) 833 | 590 | 1784】 but recovery usually depends on the recipient’s cooperation【(+1) 833🍁590🍁1784】
